nom: Dr. Melaxin Calcium Volume Eye Patch

avis.texte: As someone who's had puffy, hallow under eye bags for the last decade, I've tried about 14 different eye patch brands and this is by far the best one!! The before and after difference is recognizable and the price is v reasonable.
I absolutely love these! I havent found anything thats works as well for volume under my eyes

I think these really do help my under eyes look less puffy and helps the darkness. I keep mine in the fridge and on the weekends I love waking up and putting them on while I have my coffee. I like that they are clear so they aren't really noticeable, if you wanted to wear them on a plane or on a walk. They stay on really well, I've put them on while cleaning my house and forgot I had them on because they don't feel like much and they leave my eyes feeling hydrated and refreshed.
I've tried so many different eye patches, but these have shown the best results in hydrating my hollow under eyes & maintaining moisture all day
